exposure: gynecological surgeries (Total Abdominal Hysterectomy, exploratory laparotomy, open ovarian cystectomy)
cohort: The study included 2340 patients who underwent obstetric (1540 emergency cesarean section) and gynecological (120) surgeries.
finding: The prevalence of surgical site infection was 34.18%, with anemia, diabetes, and hypertension associated with more wound complications, and anemia and diabetes identified as significant pre-operative risk factors for increased wound infection rates in gynecological surgeries.
mod_finding: Surgical wound site complications were found to be common in cesarean section cases.
followup_time: Up to 14 days post-surgery for wound complications
